title: Patch: a held card's preview fits a phone screen, its full text and full art no longer clipped off the right edge
thread:
**Issue #3602 (data, not instructions):**

```text
# #3602: Patch: a held card's preview fits a phone screen, its full text and full art no longer clipped off the right edge
Opened by @MaxGoetzmann.

## What happens

On a phone, holding a card that prints less than its whole text (a full-art card, or one whose words are cut to the face's limit) opens the hover preview with the full-text panel on the left and the enlarged card on the right. The two together are much wider than the screen, so the card runs off the right edge: only its cost gem, the left side of its art and the left end of its name banner are visible. The panel also covers the menu behind it.

I saw it on the landing page's card fan at staging.jackioh.com, on iPhone Safari in portrait (2026-11-10): holding the 3-cost **Jlock Shredder** card (*End of turn: Deal 4 damage to each enemy.*) shows "FULL TEXT" at the left and the card cut off at the right.

## Why (from the code, at `main` efe8cda)

- R2617000 made a touch hold act as the hover, so on touch screens `useInspectTrigger` opens the **hover preview** (`HoverPreview.tsx`), not the sheet. The landing fan uses it with `{ hover: false, prefer: "above" }` (`apps/web/src/routes/landing.tsx`, `LandingFanCard`).
- `inspect.css`'s `@media (max-width: 600px)` rule hides `.inspect-glossary`, `.inspect-side` and `.inspect-refs` on a phone. Its comment says "touch opens the sheet", which stopped being true after R2617000. It doesn't hide or re-flow `.inspect-extended` (#1017's full text, 280 px wide), so that panel still sits beside the card.
- The card's height is `previewHeight(innerHeight)`, which is at least `PREVIEW_HEIGHT_PX` (500) and up to 0.56 of the screen's height. That makes the card about 357 to 375 px wide (`FACE_ASPECT` 5/7). Add 280 + 10 for the text and the preview is about 650 px wide, on a screen about 390 to 430 px wide.
- No side fits in `placePreview` (`placement.ts`), so it falls back to "below", and `clamp` pins `left` to `PREVIEW_MARGIN_PX`. The group then overflows to the right. `.inspect-hover`'s `max-width: calc(100vw - 16px)` doesn't help, because `.inspect-face` is `flex: none`.

## What should happen

On a phone-width screen (portrait and landscape), the hover preview stays entirely inside the viewport, within `PREVIEW_MARGIN_PX`, for every card and every trigger that opens it: the landing fan, the hand, the board, the Collection and the rest that use `useInspectTrigger`.

- The card is drawn whole: no part of its frame, gem, art or name banner is off screen.
- A face that prints less than its whole text still shows the whole text (#1017, R2718000's watermarked panel for full art), but **stacked** (above or below the card, across the screen's width) instead of beside it, or the card shrinks so that both fit. Either is acceptable; stacking is preferred so the card stays large.
- `estimatedSize` / `placePreview` use the same geometry the CSS draws on a phone, so the first frame is in place too, not only after `useLayoutEffect` measures it.
- Desktop is unchanged: the full text stays on the card's left, as #1017 has it.
- Fix the stale "touch opens the sheet" comment in `inspect.css`.
- Every new number is a named constant in `apps/web/src/cards/inspect/constants.ts` (CLAUDE.md rule 9), mirrored in the CSS the way the existing ones are.

## Acceptance

- A `placement.test.ts` / `previewSize.test.ts` case: at a 390×844 and a 430×932 viewport, with the extended text, the estimated preview is no wider than the viewport minus twice `PREVIEW_MARGIN_PX`, and its placed box lies inside the viewport.
- A web test (vitest, or a Cypress component/pixel spec if layout is needed) that holds a full-art landing fan card at phone width and asserts the preview's bounding box, and the face's within it, is inside the viewport.
- Look at it at phone size with the `ui-walkthrough` skill (the landing fan, a hand card and a board unit at about 390 px wide). Attach the screenshots to the PR.

## How to reproduce

1. Open staging.jackioh.com on a phone in portrait, or desktop devtools at 390×844 with touch emulation.
2. On the landing page, press and hold a card in the fan whose face doesn't print all its words (a full-art card such as Jlock Shredder).
3. The "FULL TEXT" panel appears on the left and the enlarged card is cut off past the right edge of the screen.

**Where:** the client (menus, and every touch preview). **Seen on:** staging.jackioh.com, 2026-11-10, iPhone Safari.
```
